== Summary ==
Identified: [[Chad Claseman]] (left, light blue polo) and [[Mark Walseth]] (right, navy T-shirt and glasses; matches [[:File:2002 Bespin Regionals game 2 Peter Jacobson vs Mark Walseth.jpg]] and [[:File:25 May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament Rosemount crew.jpg]], while Mark Peterson is visible at the background table). Remaining background faces unlabeled.

== Description ==

Game 3: Chad vs. Mark. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
